dossiers.thesis_summary: Anaphylm (oral sublingual epinephrine) is on a post-CRL repair path: the Jan-30-2026 CRL deficiencies (human factors, packaging, one supportive PK study) were addressed with clean topline results announced 8/10/26 (pouch-open 17s to 3s, placement errors down >80%, self-admin PK comparable), and management reaffirmed on 8/11 an NDA resubmission on or before 9/30/26. The resubmission is company-controlled and NOT yet filed as of 8/25 (EDGAR through 8/18: only Forms 4 after the 8/10-8/11 disclosures), so no FDA action date exists; a Class 2 classification (new clinical data) implies a six-month review and a decision ~Mar-Apr 2027 on a 9/30 filing. Approval by 2027-06-30 unlocks ~$95M contingent, non-dilutive funding ($75M RTW purchase, $20M Oaktree Tranche B). The edge case has compressed: at 4.80 (8/24 close, $602M mcap) AQST trades ABOVE the approved-and-launched needle-free comp ARS Pharmaceuticals/SPRY (5.35, $531M, ~$117M TTM revenue), so the market-implied win probability is already rich.
dossiers.kill_risk: The catalyst is still self-declared: five weeks before the guided 9/30 deadline no resubmission has been filed, and the FDA cannot start a clock on an unfiled application. The new PK and HF studies make Class 2 (six-month review) the likely classification — management itself concedes expedited review cannot be guaranteed — so any slip of the filing into Q4 pushes the decision into Q2-2027, up against the 2027-06-30 RTW/Oaktree approval deadlines: the same slip that costs time forfeits ~$95M of non-dilutive funding on a balance sheet with a $56.6M stockholders' deficit and ~$89M of pre-sold revenue/royalty claims senior to the equity. Meanwhile the price already exceeds the approved comp (SPRY $531M), so even a clean approval may deliver little upside versus the comp-marked win leg (~$5.00).

dossiers.thesis_summary: Face-to-face FDA meeting on a potential accelerated-approval pathway for WVE-006 (GalNAc RNA-editing oligo) in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency. Meeting is GRANTED and stated in the 7/30 10-Q and press release as scheduled for end of summer 2026; no outcome disclosed as of 2026-08-25 (no 8-K since 7/30 other than the completed Delaware redomiciliation, 8/7-8/10). Timeline has slipped once (mid-2026 feedback guided 2/2/2026 -> end-of-summer meeting), and disclosure waits on written minutes (~30 days post-meeting), so the company update most plausibly lands Oct-Nov 2026, Fall investor day the natural venue. Binary axes on the skeptic-corrected 204.0m economic share count: favorable ~$7.35, adverse ~$2.90; at the live $5.12 print (52wk low $5.01) the market implies ~50% — no demonstrated mispricing edge, but the event itself is real, idiosyncratic, and unfired. Cash $490.6m, runway into Q3-2028 verified.
dossiers.kill_risk: Disclosure is fully at management's discretion: the meeting may already have occurred with an unfavorable answer being sat on until the fall investor day, leaving the position exposed to a stale-information tape for 2-3 months. And the win leg is structurally capped: a favorable pathway headline is the trigger for the live $250m Jefferies ATM (~25% of the $1.01bn market cap, re-registered 8/10 post-redomiciliation, zero drawn in H1) plus 24.3m options / 3.2m RSUs (~13% overhang) — so realized upside on a win likely undershoots the $7.35 parts number. At corrected axes the market-implied win prob (~50%) matches base rates for pathway meetings; expected value at $5.12 is approximately zero — the edge, if any, is timing/positioning, not price.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Dated binary: Q4 2026 ECLIPSE 1 Phase 3 topline for elebsiran+tobevibart in chronic hepatitis delta, backed by Phase 2 SOLSTICE (88% ITT HDV-RNA target-not-detected at Wk96 vs 53% antibody mono) against a deferred-treatment control — technical success probability high (~0.80). Balance sheet is strong ($1.01B cash 6/30/26, runway into H2 2028, no debt, no going-concern). But on honest levels the asymmetry is modest, not the board's 9:1 — win-leg ~$12 vs floor ~$3.5 from $9.91 means the market already implies ~75% success; a win pays ~+21% at the event (full filing package waits on ECLIPSE 2, Q1 2027), a miss loses ~65%. Un-dated takeout optionality (record 2026 late-stage biotech M&A; Gilead/GSK plausible) sits on top of, not inside, these numbers.

dossiers.dossier_note: Verified live 25 Aug 2026. Catalyst real and unfired: Q2 release 10 Aug 2026 — OPERA-01 enrollment complete, topline moved to Q1 2027 (from 2H/fall 2026 = SLIPPED, from->to named above). SEC tape: 10-Q + results 8-K on 08-10, CFO-appointment 8-K + Form 3 on 08-13, NOTHING since — no readout, no raise, no second slip. ARITHMETIC (the board's numbers were built on a wrong denominator, per the fresh skeptic pass which I independently confirmed): true economic share count = 87,497,607 common (10-Q cover, as of 06 Aug 2026) + 13,594,149 pre-funded warrants at $0.0001 ("exercise is virtually assured", Note 12) = 101,091,756. Market cap at $10.43 is therefore ~$1,054M, not the quote-feed's $911M. Balance sheet 6/30/26: cash $48.6M + ST investments $412.5M = $461.1M, debt $0.7M -> net cash ~$460M = $4.55/sh. Burn: Q2 cash decline $44.3M (net loss $63.2M incl. non-cash); ~3 quarters to a Q1 2027 readout at $45-50M/qtr -> ~$315-325M at readout = $3.12-3.21/sh; failure floor $2.90 after wind-down haircut. Win leg $11.25 = ESR1m-only-label base case (elacestrant/Orserdu precedent; palazestrant would be a later entrant into a capped ESR1m niche also contested by vepdegestrant) on 101.09M shares. Upside scenario NOT in the target: OPERA-01 powers PFS separately in ESR1m AND non-ESR1m — a clean all-comers win would support materially more than $11.25, and the 2026 late-stage-takeout regime adds undated optionality; no lift applied because pivotal data is not in hand and I have no named oral-SERD takeout comp to cite. R:R at $10.43: +7.9% to $11.25 vs -72% to $2.90 (~0.11:1); blended at 60% win = 0.6(11.25)+0.4(2.90) = $7.91, BELOW the live price — market-implied win prob vs my legs is (10.43-2.90)/(11.25-2.90) = 0.90. Per the takeout-regime rule: XBI-era pricing means the old max-fear floor prints ($5.36 year-low) are not evidence the floor holds at $4+; my floor is cash-derived, not chart-derived. New CFO (8-K 13 Aug 2026) framed around launch prep — signal cuts both ways (management confidence vs. equity-raise intent). CRO owns the trade call; these are the corrected axes.
dossiers.kill_risk: Two credible residuals against the load-bearing "live floor + Q1 2027 window" claim: (1) FINANCING — the floor math assumes no equity raise before readout; a launch-experienced CFO hired 13 Aug 2026, zero revenue, and ~$45-60M/qtr burn make a pre-data or on-data raise likely, and any offering below ~$10 rebases every per-share level lower (the pre-funded-warrant structure shows this management will issue paper). (2) SECOND SLIP — Q1 2027 is the company's judgement on an event-driven PFS trial, not a commitment; guidance has already moved once (2H26 -> Q1 27) and event under-accrual could move it again. Additionally, even a statistically positive readout confined to the ESR1m subgroup may fail to clear the $11.25 win leg given Orserdu incumbency and vepdegestrant competition — a "win" that lands as a niche third entrant.

dossiers.kill_risk: The 0.75 win-read leans on C-BEYOND, which was a North American, predominantly GT1 population; C-FORWARD's 17-country ex-NA cohort carries a materially higher genotype-3 share where nucleotide/NS5A regimens have historically run thinner margins — a non-inferiority miss there drops the stock toward decaying net cash (~$1.70, -69% from $5.51). Compounding: management guidance has slipped twice in one quarter (readout YE26 -> early Q1 27; NDA Mar 27 -> Q2 27), and the pre-data strategic process (Evercore, concluded Nov 2025) already tested and failed the takeout branch. At $5.51 the tape has pre-paid most of the win leg, so the residual holder is short a rich implied probability with an asymmetric left tail.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Binary FDA event: mitapivat sNDA in sickle cell disease under priority review on the accelerated-approval pathway, PDUFA goal date 2026-11-01 — confirmed unfired by the 2026-07-07 acceptance PR, the 2026-07-30 Q2 release/10-Q, and live wires through 2026-08-25; no advisory committee announced. Balance sheet de-risks the lose leg: $964.8M cash vs $82.4M total liabilities (all leases, no debt) as of 6/30/26, ~$0.82B net cash (~$13.6/sh on 59.7M sh) projected at the decision date, plus an approved and inflecting PKD/thalassemia franchise ($44.7M Q2 worldwide revenue, ~$180M annualized, AQVESME 442 cumulative US scripts). Win leg = cash + franchise at 4.5x (~$14-15/sh) + SCD label at $700-900M (~$13.4/sh) = ~$42, corroborated by sell-side mean $42.67 / median $41. Lose leg = cash + franchise de-rated to 3x = ~$23, corroborated by the 2025-11-19 tape (closed ~1.09x then-net-cash). At $32.64 the market implies ~50.7% approval odds vs my underwritten ~60% — a real but modest edge on a package that is statistically significant only on hemolysis endpoints (hemoglobin, bilirubin) after the SCPC co-primary missed (p=0.1213) and the testing hierarchy broke.
dossiers.kill_risk: The trade requires FDA to grant accelerated approval on a hemolysis surrogate after the functional co-primary (pain crises) formally missed and fatigue showed no signal — directly in the shadow of voxelotor/Oxbryta, which got SCD accelerated approval on hemoglobin alone and was withdrawn in 2024 when clinical benefit failed to confirm. A CRL, a late-cycle AdCom call-up, or a 3-month PDUFA extension leaves ~-30% to the floor, and the corrected axes make this roughly 1:1, not the board's implied 1.6:1: at $32.64 vs $42/$23 the payoff is +28.7%/-29.5% and EV at a 60% win is only ~+5%. Secondary: recurring Pomerantz investigation PRs (07-28 through 08-13) signal securities-suit risk tied to the Nov-2025 RISE UP disclosure narrative.

dossiers.dossier_note: All catalyst facts re-verified live 2026-08-25: sNDA submitted 2026-05-12, accepted with priority review 2026-07-07, PDUFA 2026-11-01, accelerated-approval pathway, REIGNITE confirmatory trial initiated, no AdCom announced. Cash $964.8M / liabilities $82.4M (all leases) tie to the 10-Q filed 2026-07-30. Arithmetic: win $42 = 13.6 net cash (964.8M - ~4mo x $29.4M/mo filed burn, /59.7M sh) + 14.4 franchise (4.5x ~$180M run-rate; Q2 rev $44.7M x4 = $179M confirms base) + 13.4 SCD ($800M mid); lose $23 = 13.6 + ~9.2 (3x de-rate); at $32.64 implied p = (32.64-23)/(42-23) = 50.7%. Since the 08-04 board mark: (1) tebapivat Phase 2 SCD DISCONTINUED 07-21 (no differentiated profile) — does not touch the mitapivat catalyst but thins the follow-on pipeline and raises the binary's weight in the equity; (2) recurring Pomerantz investigation PRs (no filed complaint found) — noise unless approval fails. Endpoint nuance both prior records got half-right: RISE UP has no protocol transfusion endpoint (that is REIGNITE's), but the 2026-06-13 EHA PR does present NEW post-hoc analyses claiming clinically meaningful transfusion-burden reduction — company-presented, non-inferential, FDA may discount it. TAKEOUT LENS: commercial-stage rare-hematology asset with two approved indications fits the 2026 late-stage M&A regime and Pfizer (post-Oxbryta SCD gap; GBT $5.4B, Aug-2022) is a plausible acquirer, but the only direct SCD comp is pre-withdrawal 2022 vintage — no recent comp provenance, so no lift to the $42 win leg; takeout is undated optionality only. XBI-regime caveat applies: the $22.24 max-fear print predates the Dec-2025 US thalassemia approval and May-2026 EU label, so the floor is better-supported today than the low suggests, but a rejection can still overshoot $23 intraday.
